Observation: - Bo Welch: Robert W. "Bo" Welch (born November 27, 1951) is an American film production designer and director. He has been nominated for four Academy Awards for Best Art Direction. Welch made his directorial debut with the 2003 film The Cat in the Hat.
- Production designer: A production designer is the person responsible for the visual concept of a film, television or theatre production. They identify a design style for sets, locations, graphics, props, lighting, camera angles and costumes, while working closely with the director and producer.
